H = params['height']
R = params['rim_diameter'] / 2
F = params['base_diameter'] / 2
T = params['wall']
footH = H * 0.09
waistH = H * 0.14
floorH = waistH + T
# 闭合材料截面：圈足外侧 -> 杯口 -> 内腔 -> 底板 -> 圈足内侧
profile = cq.Workplane('XZ').moveTo(F-T, 0).lineTo(F, 0).lineTo(F, footH)
profile = profile.lineTo(F*0.92, waistH)
profile = profile.threePointArc((R*0.85, H*0.35), (R*0.93, H*0.72))
profile = profile.threePointArc((R*0.945, H*0.90), (R, H))
profile = profile.lineTo(R-T, H)
profile = profile.threePointArc((R*0.945-T, H*0.90), (R*0.93-T, H*0.72))
profile = profile.threePointArc((R*0.85-T, H*0.35), (F*0.92-T, floorH))
profile = profile.lineTo(0, floorH).lineTo(0, waistH).lineTo(F-T, waistH).close()
result = profile.revolve(360, (0,0), (0,1))
